question: Should #36630 continue as the canonical Signal quote-reply implementation, or should maintainers consolidate around #95718 for native quote delivery and #98289/#98287 for the BodyForAgent gap?
rationale: The branch overlaps an active maintainer Signal quote PR and changes public plugin SDK reply payload semantics, so automation cannot safely choose the permanent product/API boundary.

options.title: Consolidate around maintainer paths
options.body: Use #95718 as the native quote-delivery direction and the narrower #98289/#98287 path for agent-facing quoted context, then close or substantially narrow #36630.

options.title: Repair this PR before merge
options.body: Keep #36630 open only if it removes or gets approval for the public null SDK contract, fixes BodyForAgent quote preservation, and adds live Signal proof.

options.title: Approve broad SDK change intentionally
options.body: Maintainers can bless null reply suppression as public plugin API, but this requires docs, contract tests, and upgrade proof before merge.

recommendation.title: Consolidate around maintainer paths
recommendation.body: Use #95718 as the native quote-delivery direction and the narrower #98289/#98287 path for agent-facing quoted context, then close or substantially narrow #36630.

likelyOwner.reason: The open maintainer-labeled Signal native quote PR makes this the best available owner for the canonical Signal quote direction decision.
